title: ReGE: Stronger Agents through Experience Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2610.33861v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Repeated attempts at interactive tasks uncover facts, useful operations, and failures that can inform subsequent execution. We introduce ReGE, a framework for turning this recorded experience into guidance for a fresh attempt. Its main implementation, ReGE-Syn, uses a single coach call to jointly synthesize bounded execution records and available artifacts into self-contained guidance, connecting task-specific findings with proposed actions and relevant pitfalls. A student starts from the task's initial environment state and adapts this guidance to current observations. Source generation, synthesis, and student execution use the same base model, without parameter updates or a stronger teacher. Across four benchmarks, ReGE improves accuracy by an average of 9.9 percentage points for GPT and 8.8 percentage points for Claude compared with unguided execution. translated_title: ReGE：通过经验合成打造更强的智能体
translated_abstract: 在交互式任务中的反复尝试能够揭示事实、有用的操作以及失败的教训，这些信息可以指导后续的执行。我们提出了ReGE，一个将记录的经验转化为对新尝试指导的框架。其主要实现ReGE-Syn通过单次“教练”调用，将有界的执行记录与可用工件共同合成为自包含的指导，将任务特定的发现与建议的操作以及相关陷阱连接起来。学生模型从任务的初始环境状态开始，并根据当前的观察来调整这些指导。源经验生成、合成与学生执行均使用同一个基础模型，无需参数更新，也不需要更强的教师模型。在四个基准测试中，与无指导执行相比，ReGE使GPT的准确率平均提升9.9个百分点，使Claude的准确率平均提升8.8个百分点。在匹配的BrowseComp-Plus子集上，ReGE-Syn减少了构建指导所需的token消耗。
tldr: ReGE框架通过将智能体的历史执行经验合成为自包含指导供学生模型参考，在同款基础模型、无需参数更新或更强教师模型的情况下，使GPT和Claude在多个基准测试上的准确率平均提升约9至10个百分点。
en_tdlr: ReGE synthesizes recorded task experience into self-contained guidance, improving agent accuracy by an average of ~9 percentage points for GPT and Claude across four benchmarks—using only the same base model, without parameter updates or a stronger teacher.
